result.note: Tests the draft V2V mandate (ministry, rules amended, dates, C-V2X band) and the separate AIS-209 framework for two-wheeled ambulances.

questions.prompt: In August 2026, a draft notification proposed mandatory Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) communication systems in new vehicles in India. Consider the following statements about it:
items: It was issued by the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways as an amendment to the Central Motor Vehicles Rules.
It proposes that fitment of V2V systems becomes compulsory from October 1, 2027.
The technology it specifies, Cellular Vehicle-to-Everything (C-V2X), runs on the 5.9 GHz band that the Department of Telecommunications had exempted from licensing.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because compulsory fitment starts from October 1, 2028. October 1, 2027 is only the date from which vehicles that carry a V2V system must conform to AIS-230. The system broadcasts position, speed, direction and braking status over radio, so it reaches vehicles that cameras and radar cannot see.

questions.prompt: In August 2026, the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways proposed a first regulatory framework for two-wheeled road ambulances. Which Automotive Industry Standard does the framework adopt?
questions.explain: The framework adopts AIS-209 for L2-category machines fitted with a stretcher or patient-conveyance unit, from October 1, 2027. AIS-230 is the standard for the separate V2V communication mandate. The ambulances are aimed at rural, remote and hilly areas, and each state decides where they may operate.
questions.source: The same day, the ministry proposed a first regulatory framework for two-wheeled road ambulances, adopting standard AIS-209 for L2-category machines fitted with a stretcher or patient-conveyance unit, also from October 1, 2027.
